title: Five Journey pages share one address and canonicalize to another, and a help article has its category's title

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (backwards test from the production crawl: head tags compared page by page)

detail: Mega pass 2026-11-19, comparing every crawled page's head. (1) /discover/journeys/<slug> for the five Creator Lab courses set og:url to itself while its canonical was /courses/<slug>, so a share card and a search engine named two different addresses for one page. og:url now is the canonical. (2) /help/membership/the-vault had the title 'Membership & the Vault', the same as its category page /help/membership, so the two competed for one search result. The article is now 'What membership includes and how the Vault works', and the one link that named it follows.

verify.note: Fails on main: the journey og:url is its own path and two help pages share a title. Passes when og:url is the canonical and every help title is distinct.
